profile.name: 皮秒延时模块
profile.description: 这是一种用于对触发信号或脉冲输出进行超短时间延迟控制的电子定时模块，可在皮秒量级设置延迟，并可配置输出脉宽、触发电平、触发沿和分频等参数。它常用于时间分辨测量、激光与探测器同步、门控触发和精密时序调整实验。
profile.description_en: This is an electronic timing module used to apply ultra-short delays to trigger signals or pulse outputs, with delay settings in the picosecond range. It also allows configuration of output pulse width, trigger level, trigger edge, and frequency division. It is commonly used in time-resolved measurements, synchronization of lasers and detectors, gated triggering, and precision timing adjustment experiments.
